title: Seed1.5-VL Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 多模态前沿模型技术报告
best_for_zh: 审计多模态后训练中数据与反馈披露边界的读者
one_line: Seed1.5-VL discloses a 3T-scale multimodal pipeline and hybrid RLHF/RLVR recipe, while releasing API access and sample code rather than model weights or training records.
Seed1.5-VL 报告了彼此分离的数据构建、SFT、RLHF 与 RLVR 阶段，但未确立可复用数据工件或完整、可审计的反馈配方。
why: It is a high-information disclosure ledger for multimodal post-training because it connects images, prompts, LongCoT traces, preference rewards and rule verifiers without making the hidden data reusable.
inclusion_reason: A detailed multimodal frontier report covering source categories, synthetic construction, SFT selection, human and model preference feedback, task verifiers, hybrid PPO and iterative trace reuse, while withholding the underlying corpus and weights.

title: Problem
问题
html: Multimodal reasoning pipelines combine images, video, text, coordinates, actions, long reasoning traces, human preferences, learned judges, and executable feedback. A report can disclose impressive scale without making the underlying records auditable or reusable. Seed1.5-VL is valuable because it exposes many construction and optimization details across pre-training, SFT, RLHF, and RLVR; the remaining task is to separate those disclosures from the model's API availability, sample-code repository, and benchmark claims.
多模态推理流水线同时涉及图像、视频、文本、坐标、动作、长推理轨迹、人类偏好、学习式 judge 和可执行反馈。技术报告即使披露了很大规模，也不等于底层记录可审计或可复用。Seed1.5-VL 的价值在于，它公开了预训练、SFT、RLHF 与 RLVR 的大量构造和优化细节；审计任务则是把这些披露与模型 API、示例代码仓库及 benchmark 主张严格分开。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Seed1.5-VL treats multimodal capability as a staged data problem. A 532M SeedViT and an internal MoE language model with about 20B active parameters are joined through an adapter, then trained through adapter alignment, 3T-token multimodal pre-training, and a 240B-token balanced long-context stage. Capability-specific data covers image-text knowledge, OCR, grounding and counting, 3D perception, video, STEM, and GUI interaction.

Post-training alternates between curated SFT and online reinforcement learning. General prompts receive a learned VLM preference reward; verifiable prompts receive symbolic, geometric, constraint, string, or environment rewards. Only the final generated output is scored. Correct RL responses are recycled into the next LongCoT SFT round, with the report documenting four such iterations.

Seed1.5-VL 把多模态能力视为分阶段的数据问题。532M 参数的 SeedViT 与约 20B 激活参数的内部 MoE 语言模型通过 adapter 连接，随后依次进行 adapter 对齐、3T-token 多模态预训练和 240B-token 的均衡长上下文阶段。按能力划分的数据覆盖图文知识、OCR、grounding 与 counting、3D 感知、视频、STEM 和 GUI 交互。

后训练在精选 SFT 与在线强化学习之间迭代。通用提示由学习式 VLM 偏好模型评分，可验证提示则接收符号、几何、约束、字符串或环境奖励。监督只作用于最终生成结果。回答正确的 RL 轨迹会回流到下一轮 LongCoT SFT，报告称当前模型经历了四轮此类迭代。

title: Method
方法
html:
Pre-training data are organized by target capability rather than published as a source manifest. Web image-text pairs are filtered by similarity, image and text criteria, exact or near-image deduplication, and URL/domain rules; rare concepts are identified with a precursor VLM and underrepresented domains are upsampled. OCR construction includes more than one billion in-house samples, over 200M synthetic text-heavy images, more than 100M chart examples, and over 50M rendered tables. Grounding uses selected public datasets and automatic web-image annotation: the report identifies 48M multi-task samples plus 200M auto-annotated samples, about 170M pointing instructions, and 8M counting samples. Other categories include generated or public 3D data, video captions and temporal tasks, over 100M processed K-12 exercises, synthetic STEM diagrams, and UI-TARS-derived GUI observations, thoughts, and actions.

The three VLM stages train the adapter for 16B tokens at length 32,768, all parameters for 3T tokens at length 32,768, then all parameters for 240B tokens at length 131,072 with a more balanced mixture including video, code, and 3D. The report supplies batch and learning-rate schedules, but not an immutable mixture or record ledger.

SFT begins with about 13k crowdsourced image-prompt-response records. A collected 1.5M open-source pool is clustered with a proprietary image-text embedding model, downsampled by task, rolled out by the SFT model, judged against references by an LLM, and ranked by a reward model to yield about 30k samples. Self-instruct combinations are manually checked. The final multimodal SFT set is about 50k records, mixed with internal text-only SFT and LongCoT data for two epochs. Separate system-level instructions switch concise and LongCoT modes.

RLHF uses listwise multimodal preferences from humans and heuristic synthesis. Human annotators apply a five-level scale, choose a minimally editable response, and mark problems such as hallucination or poor helpfulness; candidate responses are diversity-filtered before annotation. Synthetic preferences rank repeated generations by correctness and format against known answers and include caption pairs designed to reduce hallucination. A generative pairwise VLM reward model evaluates both response orders to reduce positional bias. RL prompts are capability-tagged, stratified, filtered when reward variation is too small, and later downsampled when reward and KL rise too quickly.

RLVR covers more than one million image-based STEM problems, grounding and pointing, regex-verifiable visual instructions, over 20k synthetic puzzles, and visual games. STEM multiple choice is converted to open response; text-only shortcuts, multi-question or complex-reference items, and questions solved 0% or above 75% across 16 SFT samples are removed. SymPy checks final expressions. IoU or point agreement grades localization, regex or string matching grades constrained outputs and puzzles, and interactive outcomes support games.

Hybrid PPO shuffles general and verifiable prompts together. A format gate requires a reasoning block and final solution; the reward model sees only the solution, not the reasoning trace. A shared critic handles reward-model and verifier scores normalized to [0,1]. General prompts use KL 1e-5 and one rollout; verifiable prompts use zero KL and four or eight rollouts. Each episode has 4,096 rollouts, eight updates with minibatches of 512, context length 8,192, and maximum output length 16,384. Correct verifier-approved RL traces feed four rounds of rejection-sampling SFT after regex removal of repetition, overthinking, and linguistic artifacts.

预训练数据按目标能力组织，而不是作为来源清单发布。Web 图文对经过相似度、图像和文本规则、图像精确或近似去重以及 URL/域名过滤；前代 VLM 用于识别稀有概念，低频领域被上采样。OCR 构造包括超过 10 亿条内部样本、超过 2 亿张合成密集文本图像、超过 1 亿个图表样本和超过 5000 万张渲染表格。grounding 结合筛选后的公开数据与 Web 图像自动标注：报告给出 4800 万多任务样本和 2 亿自动标注样本、约 1.7 亿 pointing 指令，以及 800 万 counting 样本。其他类别包括生成或公开的 3D 数据、视频描述与时序任务、超过 1 亿道处理后的 K-12 练习、合成 STEM 图示，以及从 UI-TARS 派生的 GUI 观察、思考和动作。

三个 VLM 阶段分别用 16B token、长度 32,768 训练 adapter；用 3T token、长度 32,768 训练全部参数；再用 240B token、长度 131,072 训练更均衡且加入视频、代码和 3D 的混合数据。报告给出 batch 和学习率日程，但没有不可变的混合表或逐条记录账本。

SFT 首先获得约 1.3 万条众包图像—提示—回答记录。收集的 150 万开源数据池由专有图文 embedding 模型聚类并按任务下采样，再由 SFT 模型多次 rollout；LLM 参照原始答案判定正确性，reward model 进一步按人类偏好筛选，最终得到约 3 万条。self-instruct 组合结果还会人工复核。最终多模态 SFT 集约 5 万条，并与内部纯文本 SFT 和 LongCoT 数据混合训练两个 epoch；不同系统级指令用于切换简洁回答和 LongCoT。

RLHF 使用人工和启发式合成的 listwise 多模态偏好。人工标注采用五级评分，要求选出最少修改即可改正的回答，并标记幻觉、helpfulness 等问题；候选回答在标注前经过多样性过滤。合成偏好根据已知答案，对多次生成的正确性和格式排序，并加入用于减少幻觉的 caption 偏好对。生成式 pairwise VLM reward model 同时评估两种回答顺序，以减轻位置偏差。RL 提示先做能力标签和分层抽样，reward 差异过小时删除；训练初期 reward 与 KL 同时快速增长的提示会被下采样。

RLVR 包含超过 100 万道带图 STEM 题、grounding 和 pointing、可由正则验证的视觉指令、超过 2 万道合成 puzzle，以及视觉游戏。STEM 选择题被改为开放回答；可由纯文本捷径求解、含多问或复杂参考答案的题被删除。每题由 SFT 模型采样 16 次，正确率为 0% 或高于 75% 的题也被删除。SymPy 检查最终表达式，IoU 或点位一致性检查定位结果，正则或字符串匹配检查受约束输出和 puzzle，交互式结果则用于游戏。

混合 PPO 将通用提示与可验证提示打乱混合。格式门要求推理区块后给出最终解答；reward model 只看到解答，不看到推理轨迹。共享 critic 处理归一化到 [0,1] 的 reward-model 和 verifier 分数。通用提示使用 1e-5 的 KL 和一次 rollout，可验证提示使用零 KL 和四次或八次 rollout。每个 episode 有 4,096 次 rollout，并以 512 的 minibatch 更新八次；上下文长度为 8,192，最大输出长度为 16,384。经 verifier 确认正确的 RL 轨迹回流到四轮拒绝采样 SFT，同时用正则去除重复、过度思考和语言伪影。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The report provides quantitative construction evidence, optimizer settings, compute totals, and a concrete feedback partition. It reports 1.3M H800-normalized GPU hours for pre-training, 60k for RL, and 24k for reward-model training. It also reports state-of-the-art results on 38 of 60 public benchmarks and 77.9 on MMMU, alongside public, internal, GUI, video, and gameplay evaluations. These measurements support claims about the described system's evaluated behavior and pipeline scale; they do not prove that the hidden data are correctly licensed, uncontaminated, complete, or reproducible.

The public artifacts are narrower. The official GitHub repository provides the technical report, API cookbooks, demos, examples, and Apache-2.0-licensed repository code. The official Hugging Face artifact is an API-backed Space, and the release points to Volcano Engine model ID doubao-1-5-thinking-vision-pro-250428. The checked official artifacts do not provide Seed1.5-VL weight files, a weight model card, the training corpus, SFT or preference records, LongCoT traces, reward-model weights, or verifier implementations. A repository license for sample code must not be transferred to those unreleased assets.

报告提供了定量构造信息、优化器设置、计算量和明确的反馈分工：预训练消耗按 H800 归一化的 130 万 GPU 小时，RL 为 6 万小时，reward model 为 2.4 万小时。报告还声称在 60 个公开 benchmark 中有 38 个达到 SOTA，并给出 MMMU 77.9，以及公开、内部、GUI、视频和游戏评测。这些数字支持“所述系统具有相应评测行为和流水线规模”，但不能证明隐藏数据授权正确、无污染、完整或可复现。

公开工件的范围更窄。官方 GitHub 仓库提供技术报告、API cookbook、demo、示例，以及采用 Apache-2.0 的仓库代码；官方 Hugging Face 工件是 API 驱动的 Space，发布页指向火山引擎模型 ID doubao-1-5-thinking-vision-pro-250428。核验到的官方工件没有提供 Seed1.5-VL 权重文件、权重模型卡、训练语料、SFT 或偏好记录、LongCoT 轨迹、reward-model 权重或 verifier 实现。示例代码的仓库许可不能转用于这些未发布资产。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For reasoning-data curation, the strongest contribution is the unified feedback ledger across modalities. General visual prompts are scored by a preference model, while STEM expressions, boxes, points, constrained instructions, puzzles, and games use task-specific verification. Both reward streams enter one PPO run, yet the reasoning trace is deliberately excluded from direct reward-model supervision. This makes the exact supervision boundary unusually clear.

The second contribution is cyclic data construction. Hard prompts drive RL; verifier-approved responses become the next LongCoT SFT data; and successive RL checkpoints become better trace generators. Pre-training also mixes human annotation, public records, web crawling, model annotation, rendering, simulation, and diffusion-based edits. The report therefore illustrates how a frontier multimodal dataset is a changing system of records, not a single static corpus.

对推理数据策展而言，最重要的贡献是跨模态统一反馈账本。通用视觉提示由偏好模型评分，STEM 表达式、box、point、受约束指令、puzzle 与游戏则由任务 verifier 评分。两种奖励进入同一次 PPO 训练，但推理轨迹被明确排除在 reward-model 直接监督之外，因此监督边界相当清晰。

第二项贡献是循环式数据构造：困难提示驱动 RL，经 verifier 确认的正确回答成为下一轮 LongCoT SFT 数据，连续的 RL 检查点又成为更强的轨迹生成器。预训练也混合了人工标注、公开记录、Web 抓取、模型标注、渲染、仿真和扩散编辑。这份报告因此展示了前沿多模态数据集如何成为持续变化的记录系统，而非单一静态语料。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
No record-level source manifest, immutable mixture table, final per-domain counts, deduplication log, source revision, license map, or released train/validation split accompanies the 3T-scale corpus. Descriptions such as web-sourced, public, internal, crawled, and open-source are not sufficient for rights or provenance audits. The paper names many generators and public datasets, but exact versions, prompts, seeds, thresholds, filtering yields, and source-to-example mappings are mostly unknown. The 50k SFT aggregate excludes undisclosed internal text-only and LongCoT counts; preference-set size, RL prompt count, candidate K, total episodes, and trace manifests are also unknown.

Feedback has bounded coverage. A final expression can match under SymPy while the visual reasoning is spurious; IoU and point rewards depend on reference geometry; regex and string checks can be gamed; a reward model can inherit annotator, model, and task-distribution bias. Evaluating both response orders addresses positional bias but not calibration or broader judge bias. Because the reasoning trace is not scored, the pipeline does not establish LongCoT faithfulness.

The report states that synthetic puzzles were decontaminated against benchmarks such as PuzzleVQA, but it does not provide a corpus-wide overlap audit for pre-training, SFT, preferences, RL prompts, or the many public and internal evaluations. Internal benchmarks and selected qualitative examples are not independently reproducible. The paper itself identifies 3D spatial imagination, hallucination, and combinatorial search as remaining model failures.

Finally, API availability and Apache-2.0 sample code do not make the model or data open. The checked official artifacts expose an API and cookbook rather than model weights, training code, reward-model checkpoints, verifiers, or datasets, so end-to-end reproduction is not possible from the release.

3T 规模语料没有配套逐条来源清单、不可变混合表、最终领域计数、去重日志、来源版本、许可映射或公开训练/验证切分。“来自 Web”“公开”“内部”“抓取”和“开源”等描述不足以支持权利或溯源审计。论文列出许多生成器和公开数据集，但具体版本、提示、随机种子、阈值、筛选产率及来源到样本映射大多为 unknown。约 5 万条 SFT 汇总不包含未披露的内部纯文本和 LongCoT 数量；偏好集规模、RL 提示数、候选 K、episode 总数和轨迹清单同样未知。

反馈覆盖范围有限。最终表达式与 SymPy 匹配时，视觉推理仍可能是伪相关；IoU 与点位奖励依赖参考几何；正则和字符串检查可能被投机；reward model 会继承标注者、模型和任务分布偏差。同时评估两种回答顺序只能缓解位置偏差，不能解决校准或更广泛的 judge 偏差。推理轨迹未被评分，因此流水线不能证明 LongCoT 忠实。

报告说明合成视觉 puzzle 会针对 PuzzleVQA 等 benchmark 去污染，但没有提供覆盖预训练、SFT、偏好、RL 提示及大量公开和内部评测的全语料重叠审计。内部 benchmark 和精选定性案例无法独立复现。论文自身也把 3D 空间想象、幻觉和组合搜索列为仍存在的模型失败。

最后，API 可用和 Apache-2.0 示例代码不等于模型或数据开放。已核验的官方工件提供 API 与 cookbook，而非模型权重、训练代码、reward-model 检查点、verifier 或数据集，因此无法据此端到端复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the frontier-reports data-disclosure ledger track, Seed1.5-VL offers a rich template for auditing multimodal post-training. A reusable ledger should assign stable IDs to every image, clip, prompt, answer, box, point, action, preference comparison, judge decision, verifier result, policy version, and selected LongCoT trace. It should also preserve source and license records, generator versions, filtering reasons, deduplication clusters, train/evaluation overlap checks, and release hashes.

The report also suggests practical dataset design. Capability taxonomies can drive balanced sampling; repeated SFT rollouts can isolate useful RLVR difficulty; text-only shortcut tests can protect visual grounding; reward-model and verifier prompts should remain distinguishable even when trained in one batch; and rejection sampling should record why each RL trace was accepted. These are valuable construction patterns, provided benchmark gains remain evaluation evidence rather than a proxy for data quality.

对“前沿报告与数据披露账本”轨道而言，Seed1.5-VL 提供了审计多模态后训练的高信息模板。可复用账本应为每幅图像、视频片段、提示、答案、box、point、动作、偏好比较、judge 决策、verifier 结果、策略版本和入选 LongCoT 轨迹分配稳定 ID；同时保存来源与许可、生成器版本、过滤原因、去重簇、训练—评测重叠检查和发布哈希。

报告也给出实用的数据设计思路：用能力分类驱动均衡采样；用重复 SFT rollout 筛选适合 RLVR 的难度；用纯文本捷径测试保护视觉 grounding；即使在同一 batch 训练，也应区分 reward-model 提示与 verifier 提示；拒绝采样还应记录每条 RL 轨迹被接受的原因。使用这些模式时，必须把 benchmark 提升保留为评测证据，而非数据质量替代指标。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Separate the 16B, 3T, and 240B VLM stages; do not collapse them into a precisely released 3.256T-token dataset.
  • The approximately 50k multimodal SFT set is mixed with internal text-only and LongCoT data whose sizes and records are not disclosed.
  • Hybrid PPO gives general prompts reward-model feedback and verifiable prompts task-specific feedback; the reward model sees only the final solution.
  • Four LongCoT iterations recycle verifier-approved RL outputs into later SFT, but trace manifests and checkpoint mappings are unavailable.
  • The official release provides API access and Apache-2.0 sample code/cookbooks, not Seed1.5-VL weights or training data.

• 区分 16B、3T 和 240B 三个 VLM 阶段，不要把它们合并成一个已精确发布的 3.256T-token 数据集。
  • 约 5 万条多模态 SFT 会与内部纯文本和 LongCoT 数据混合，后两者的规模与记录未披露。
  • 混合 PPO 对通用提示使用 reward-model 反馈，对可验证提示使用任务 verifier；reward model 只看到最终解答。
  • 四轮 LongCoT 迭代把 verifier 确认的 RL 输出回流到后续 SFT，但没有轨迹清单和检查点映射。
  • 官方发布提供 API 访问与 Apache-2.0 示例代码/cookbook，不提供 Seed1.5-VL 权重或训练数据。

title: Citation
引用
html: ByteDance Seed Team. "Seed1.5-VL Technical Report." arXiv:2505.07062, 2025. Paper · Official BibTeX · Official project · Official cookbook repository.

value.html: Pre-training combines web image-text pairs, public and internally collected image/video data, open-source datasets, crawled and manually annotated STEM material, synthetic OCR/chart/table/diagram data, and UI-TARS-derived GUI records. Post-training uses crowdsourced and selected open-source SFT prompts, self-instruct and LongCoT prompts, multimodal preference prompts, and hard verifiable visual tasks. An exhaustive record-level source manifest is not released.

General concise answers and system-prompt-selected LongCoT responses; hybrid RL requires a tagged reasoning block followed by a solution. Verifiable tasks use boxed answers, normalized boxes or points, regular-expression-constrained outputs, or executable game outcomes.

Human annotators, Seed1.5-VL and earlier internal VLM/LLM checkpoints generate or revise responses; multi-step GUI traces combine in-house and standardized open-source trajectories. Exact checkpoint-to-record mappings are unknown.
Rule and symbolic verifiers for visual STEM, grounding, pointing, constrained instructions and puzzles; interactive visual games; verl-based PPO infrastructure with vLLM rollout generation.

A generative pairwise VLM reward model for general prompts and task-specific verifiers for verifiable prompts. Final-output rewards include SymPy equivalence, bounding-box IoU, point accuracy, regular-expression constraints, string matching and environment success; chain-of-thought is not directly supervised.

Task-dependent final-output success: symbolic answer equivalence, geometric agreement with reference boxes or points, constraint or string match, or a verifiable visual-game outcome. General prompts instead receive a reward-model preference score.

A 532M-parameter SeedViT, an MLP adapter, and an internal decoder-only MoE language model with about 20B active parameters; total MoE parameters and the internal language checkpoint are not disclosed.

Previous internal VLMs, top-performing in-house models, LLM judges, the reward model and successive Seed1.5-VL RL iterations contribute annotations or selected traces; exact teacher versions are unknown.

Internal VLM/LLM checkpoints, rendering pipelines, Grounding DINO, Molmo, CountGD, Depth Anything V2, a diffusion inpainting model, and programmatic SVG/chart/table generators are used across construction stages.

Visual STEM difficulty selection generates 16 SFT responses per question and retains questions solved more than 0% but no more than 75%. Preference and RLHF curation use K candidate responses with K undisclosed. Hybrid RL samples general reward-model prompts once and verifier prompts 4 or 8 times.
4,096 rollouts per hybrid-RL episode; per-prompt count is 1 for reward-model prompts and 4 or 8 for verifier prompts. Total episodes and total rollouts are unknown.
Human-preference candidates use nucleus sampling, but top-p and temperature are unknown; other generation temperatures are not disclosed.

Pre-training uses similarity, image/text, deduplication, URL/domain, annotation-quality and capability-balancing filters. SFT selection uses clustering, targeted downsampling, multiple rollouts, LLM judging, reward-model ranking and manual verification. RLHF prompts use capability stratification and reward-variance filtering. RLVR removes trivial, unsolved, text-only-solvable and verifier-incompatible tasks.
Hybrid RL uses context length 8,192 and maximum output length 16,384. SFT uses sequence length 131,072. Pre-training stages use 32,768, 32,768 and 131,072 sequence lengths.

A PPO variant mixes RLHF and RLVR prompts, uses a shared critic initialized from the reward model, normalizes both reward sources to [0,1], applies KL coefficients 1e-5 for general prompts and 0 for verifiable prompts, and performs 8 updates of minibatch size 512 per episode.

The report gives capability categories and many subset counts for more than 3T multimodal pre-training tokens, but not a complete immutable mixture table, record manifest, source revisions, deduplication ledger or rights map. Post-training gives aggregate SFT/RLVR counts but not released records.

items: Final-output rewards do not verify the faithfulness or visual grounding of every LongCoT step.
The generative reward model can inherit judge and annotation bias; evaluating both response orders addresses positional bias only.
